title: Persian Period Finds from Jerusalem: Facts and Interpretations

verification_log.method: §2: Jerusalem destroyed and left deserted for nearly 50 years; Nehemiah's refortification in the mid-5th century would have made it a bîrāh replacing Mizpah; archaeological data "minimal"; the Western Hill "entirely abandoned" in the Persian and early Hellenistic periods, resettled in the 2nd century BCE (the common view); on the City of David: Kenyon assigned a wall to Nehemiah and the tower to the Hasmoneans; Mazar's fill under the tower is "certainly not sufficient grounds" to date the tower to the 5th century or identify it as Nehemiah's wall; De Groot and Ariel's Persian-period construction phase on the eastern slope may indicate the "missing" wall
